claim_boundary: DIRAC-015 completes the conditional free-Dirac continuum derivation. DIRAC-016 proves the scoped unsigned cube-translation copy exchange. DIRAC-017 conditionally proves that the same cubical incidence representation carries spin-one-half algebra, including continuous-angle Hamiltonian covariance. DIRAC-018 classifies the square root only within the real, local, flavor-preserving cubical-incidence coefficient class. DIRAC-019 proves sustained norm-preserving evolution and density-weighted current/group-velocity transport for arbitrary finite positive-frequency spectral families on the stable recurrence-derived continuum branch. DIRAC-020 constructs an explicit normalized finite Fourier frame, proves that periodic cubic character phases match the momenta stored in the corresponding positive-frequency modes, synthesizes those compatible modes into one coherent spatial field, proves exact Parseval density preservation and integrated-current transport for every stable update, and proves an explicit finite-update pointwise recurrence-versus-continuum error bound. It does not classify arbitrary nonlocal or flavor-mixing roots, provide a uniform fixed-physical-time convergence rate, construct an exact finite-spacing Dirac operator or exact native finite-spacing packet evolution, prove unrestricted live-chi localized electron transport, establish electromagnetic coupling or g-factor, establish electron identity or formation, or promote canonical LFM status.
